sections.label: Book 34
sections.name: The Sivasankalpa Upanishad and other prayers

verses.sa: यज्जाग्रतो दूरमुदैति दैवं तदु सुप्तस्य तथैवैति। दूरङ्गमं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिरेकं तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु॥
verses.tr: yajjāgrato dūramudaiti daivaṃ tadu suptasya tathaivaiti dūraṅgamaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirekaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu
verses.en: That which, divine, mounts far when man is waking, that which returns to him when he is sleeping, The lights' one light that goeth to a distance, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.

verses.sa: येन कर्माण्यपसो मनीषिणो यज्ञे कृण्वन्ति विदथेषु धीराः। यदपूर्वं यक्षमन्तः प्रजानां तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु॥
verses.tr: yena karmāṇyapaso manīṣiṇo yajñe kṛṇvanti vidatheṣu dhīrāḥ yadapūrvaṃ yakṣamantaḥ prajānāṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu
verses.en: Whereby the wise and thoughtful in assemblies, active in sacrifice, perform their duties. The peerless spirit stored in living' creatures, may that,, my mind, be moved by right intention.'

verses.sa: यत्प्रज्ञानमुत चेतो धृतिश्च यज्ज्योतिरन्तरमृतं प्रजासु। यस्मान्न ऋते किं चन कर्म क्रियते तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु॥
verses.tr: yatprajñānamuta ceto dhṛtiśca yajjyotirantaramṛtaṃ prajāsu yasmānna ṛte kiṃ cana karma kriyate tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu
verses.en: That which is wisdom, intellect, and firmness, immortal light which creatures have within them, That without which men do no single action, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.

verses.sa: येनेदं भूतं भुवनं भविष्यत् परिगृहीतममृतेन सर्वम्। येन यज्ञस्तायते सप्तहोता तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु॥
verses.tr: yenedaṃ bhūtaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhaviṣyat parigṛhītamamṛtena sarvam yena yajñastāyate saptahotā tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu
verses.en: Whereby, immortal, all is comprehended, the world which is, and what shall be hereafter, Whereby spreads sacrifice with seven Hotars, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.

verses.sa: यस्मिन्नृचः साम यजूंषि यस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठिता रथनाभाविवाराः। यस्मिँश्चित्तं सर्वमोतं प्रजानां तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु॥
verses.tr: yasminnṛcaḥ sāma yajūṃṣi yasmin pratiṣṭhitā rathanābhāvivārāḥ yasmiṃścittaṃ sarvamotaṃ prajānāṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu
verses.en: Wherein the Kichas, Samans, Yajur-verses, like spokes within a car's nave, are included, And all the thought of creatures is inwoven, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.

verses.sa: सुषारथिरश्वानिव यन्मनुष्यान्नेनीयतेऽभीशुभिर्वाजिन इव। हृत्प्रतिष्ठं यदजिरं जविष्ठं तन्मे मनः शिवसङ्कल्पमस्तु॥
verses.tr: suṣārathiraśvāniva yanmanuṣyānnenīyate'bhīśubhirvājina iva hṛtpratiṣṭhaṃ yadajiraṃ javiṣṭhaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu
verses.en: Controlling men, as, with the reins that guide them, a skilful charioteer drives fleet-foot horses. Which dwells 'within the heart, agile, most rapid, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.

verses.sa: पितुं नु स्तोषं महो धर्माणं तविषीम्। यस्य त्रितो व्योजसा वृत्रं विपर्वमर्दयत्॥
verses.tr: pituṃ nu stoṣaṃ maho dharmāṇaṃ taviṣīm yasya trito vyojasā vṛtraṃ viparvamardayat
verses.en: Now will I glorify great strength's upholder. Food, By whose invigorating might Trita rent limb from limb.

verses.sa: अन्विदनुमते त्वं मन्यासै शं च नस्कृधि। क्रत्वे दक्षाय नो हिनु प्र ण आयूंषि तारिषः॥
verses.tr: anvidanumate tvaṃ manyāsai śaṃ ca naskṛdhi kratve dakṣāya no hinu pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣaḥ
verses.en: Do thou, in truth, Anumati, assent and grant us ]happiness. Urge us to strength, and energy: prolong the days we have to live.

verses.sa: अनु नोऽद्यानुमतिर्यज्ञं देवेषु मन्यताम्। अग्निश्च हव्यवाहनो भवतं दाशुषे मयः॥
verses.tr: anu no'dyānumatiryajñaṃ deveṣu manyatām agniśca havyavāhano bhavataṃ dāśuṣe mayaḥ
verses.en: Anumati this day approve our sacrifice among the Gods! Oblation-bearing Agni be, and thou, bliss to the worshipper! I

verses.sa: सिनीवालि पृथुष्टुके या देवानामसि स्वसा। जुषस्व हव्यमाहुतं प्रजां देवि दिदिड्ढि नः॥
verses.tr: sinīvāli pṛthuṣṭuke yā devānāmasi svasā juṣasva havyamāhutaṃ prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ
verses.en: O broad-tressed Sinivali!, thou who art the sister of the €Gods, Accept the offered sacrifice, and, Goddess, grant us progeny.

verses.sa: पञ्च नद्यः सरस्वतीमपि यन्ति सस्रोतसः। सरस्वती तु पञ्चधा सो देशेऽभवत्सरित्॥
verses.tr: pañca nadyaḥ sarasvatīmapi yanti sasrotasaḥ sarasvatī tu pañcadhā so deśe'bhavatsarit
verses.en: Five rivers flowing on their way speed onward to Sarasvati, But then became Sarasvati a fivefold river in the and.

verses.sa: त्वमग्ने प्रथमो अङ्गिरा ऋषिर्देवो देवानामभवः शिवः सखा। तव व्रते कवयो विद्मनापसोऽजायन्त मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयः॥
verses.tr: tvamagne prathamo aṅgirā ṛṣirdevo devānāmabhavaḥ śivaḥ sakhā tava vrate kavayo vidmanāpaso'jāyanta maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ
verses.en: O Agni, thou the earliest Angiras, the Seer, hast, God. thyself, become the Gods' auspicious Friend. After thy holy ordinance the Maruts, sage, active through wisdom, with their glittering spears, were bom.

verses.sa: त्वं नो अग्ने तव देव पायुभिर्मघोनो रक्ष तन्वश्च वन्द्य। त्राता तोकस्य तनये गवामस्यनिमेषं रक्षमाणस्तव व्रते॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ no agne tava deva pāyubhirmaghono rakṣa tanvaśca vandya trātā tokasya tanaye gavāmasyanimeṣaṃ rakṣamāṇastava vrate
verses.en: Worthy to be revered, O Agni, God, preserve our wealthy patrons with thy succours, and ourselves. Guard art thou of our seed and progeny and cows, incessantly protecting in thy holy law.

verses.sa: उत्तानायामव भरा चिकित्वान्त्सद्यः प्रवीता वृषणं जजान। अरुषस्तूपो रुशदस्य पाज इडायास्पुत्रो वयुनेऽजनिष्ट॥
verses.tr: uttānāyāmava bharā cikitvāntsadyaḥ pravītā vṛṣaṇaṃ jajāna aruṣastūpo ruśadasya pāja iḍāyāsputro vayune'janiṣṭa
verses.en: Lay this with care on her who lies extended: straight, when impregned, hath she brought forth the Hero. With his bright pillar—radiant \is his lustre—in our skilled task is born the Son of Ida.

verses.sa: इडायास्त्वा पदे वयं नाभा पृथिव्या अधि। जातवेदो निधीमह्यग्ने हव्याय वोढवे॥
verses.tr: iḍāyāstvā pade vayaṃ nābhā pṛthivyā adhi jātavedo nidhīmahyagne havyāya voḍhave
verses.en: In I^a's place, the centre of the 'earth, will we deposit thee, That, Agni Jdtavedas, thou mayst bear our offerings to the Gods.

verses.sa: प्र मन्महे शवसानाय शूषमाङ्गूषं गिर्वणसे अङ्गिरस्वत्। सुवृक्तिभि स्तुवत ऋग्मियायार्चामार्कं नरे विश्रुताय॥
verses.tr: pra manmahe śavasānāya śūṣamāṅgūṣaṃ girvaṇase aṅgirasvat suvṛktibhi stuvata ṛgmiyāyārcāmārkaṃ nare viśrutāya
verses.en: Like Angiras a gladdening laud we ponder to him who loveth song, exceeding mighty. Let us sing glory to the far-famed Hero who must be praised with fair hymns by the singer.---'—'

verses.sa: प्र वो महे महि नमो भरध्वमाङ्गूष्यं शवसानाय साम। येना नः पूर्वे पितरः पदज्ञा अर्चन्तो अङ्गिरसो गा अविन्दन्॥
verses.tr: pra vo mahe mahi namo bharadhvamāṅgūṣyaṃ śavasānāya sāma yenā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ padajñā arcanto aṅgiraso gā avindan
verses.en: Unto the Great One bring great adoration, a chant of praise to him the very potent, Through whom our sires, Angirases, singing praises, and knowing well the places, found the cattle.

verses.sa: इच्छन्ति त्वा सोम्यासः सखायः सुन्वन्ति सोमं दधति प्रयांसि। तितिक्षन्ते अभिशस्तिं जनानामिन्द्र त्वदा कश्चन हि प्रकेतः॥
verses.tr: icchanti tvā somyāsaḥ sakhāyaḥ sunvanti somaṃ dadhati prayāṃsi titikṣante abhiśastiṃ janānāmindra tvadā kaścana hi praketaḥ
verses.en: The friends who offer Soma long to find thee: they pour forth Soma and present their viands. They bear, unmoved, the cursing of the people, for all our wisdom comes from thee, O Indra.

verses.sa: न ते दूरे परमा चिद्रजांस्या तु प्र याहि हरिवो हरिभ्याम्। स्थिराय वृष्णे सवना कृतेमा युक्ता ग्रावाणः समिधाने अग्नौ॥
verses.tr: na te dūre paramā cidrajāṃsyā tu pra yāhi harivo haribhyām sthirāya vṛṣṇe savanā kṛtemā yuktā grāvāṇaḥ samidhāne agnau
verses.en: Not far for thee are mid-air's loftiest regions: start hither. Lord of Bays, with both Bay Horses. Pressed for the Firm and Strong are these libations. The pressing-stones are set, the fire is kindled.

verses.sa: अषाढं युत्सु पृतनासु पप्रिं स्वर्षामप्सां वृजनस्य गोपाम्। भरेषुजां सुक्षितिं सुश्रवसं जयन्तं त्वामनु मदेम सोम॥
verses.tr: aṣāḍhaṃ yutsu pṛtanāsu papriṃ svarṣāmapsāṃ vṛjanasya gopām bhareṣujāṃ sukṣitiṃ suśravasaṃ jayantaṃ tvāmanu madema soma
verses.en: Invincible in fight, saviour in battles, guard of our camp, winner of light and water. Born amid hymns, well-housed, exceeding famous, victor, in thee may we rejoice, O Soma.

verses.sa: सोमो धेनुं सोमो अर्वन्तमाशुं सोमो वीरं कर्मण्यं ददाति। सादन्यं विदथ्यं सभेयं पितृश्रवणं यो ददाशदस्मै॥
verses.tr: somo dhenuṃ somo arvantamāśuṃ somo vīraṃ karmaṇyaṃ dadāti sādanyaṃ vidathyaṃ sabheyaṃ pitṛśravaṇaṃ yo dadāśadasmai
verses.en: To him who worships Soma gives a milch-cow, a fleet steed, and a man of active knowledge, Skilled in home duties, competent in council, meet for the court, the glory of his father.

verses.sa: त्वमिमा ओषधीः सोम विश्वास्त्वमपो अजनयस्त्वं गाः। त्वमा ततन्थोर्वन्तरिक्षं त्वं ज्योतिषा वि तमो ववर्थ॥
verses.tr: tvamimā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāstvamapo ajanayastvaṃ gāḥ tvamā tatanthorvantarikṣaṃ tvaṃ jyotiṣā vi tamo vavartha
verses.en: These herbs, these milch-kine, and these running waters, all these, O Soma, thou hast generated. The spacious firmament hast thou expanded, and with the light thou hast dispelled the darkness.

verses.sa: देवेन नो मनसा देव सोम रायो भागं सहसावन्नभि युध्य। मा त्वा तनदीशिषे वीर्यस्योभयेभ्यः प्रचिकित्सा गविष्टौ॥
verses.tr: devena no manasā deva soma rāyo bhāgaṃ sahasāvannabhi yudhya mā tvā tanadīśiṣe vīryasyobhayebhyaḥ pracikitsā gaviṣṭau
verses.en: Do thou, God Soma, with thy God-like spirit, victorious, win for us a share of riches. Let none prevent thee: thou art Lord of valour. Provide for these and those in fight for cattle.

verses.sa: अष्टौ व्यख्यत् ककुभः पृथिव्यास्त्री धन्व योजना सप्त सिन्धून्। हिरण्याक्षः सविता देव आगाद्दधद्रत्ना दाशुषे वार्याणि॥
verses.tr: aṣṭau vyakhyat kakubhaḥ pṛthivyāstrī dhanva yojanā sapta sindhūn hiraṇyākṣaḥ savitā deva āgāddadhadratnā dāśuṣe vāryāṇi
verses.en: The earth's eight points his brightness hath illumined, three desert regions, and the Seven Rivers. God Savitar the gold-eyed hath come hither, giving I choice treasures to the man who worships. both of you. With aids which none may interrupt.

verses.sa: हिरण्यपाणिः सविता विचर्षणिरुभे द्यावापृथिवी अन्तरीयते। अपामीवां बाधते वेति सूर्यमभि कृष्णेन रजसा द्यामृणोति॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā vicarṣaṇirubhe dyāvāpṛthivī antarīyate apāmīvāṃ bādhate veti sūryamabhi kṛṣṇena rajasā dyāmṛṇoti

verses.sa: हिरण्यहस्तो असुरः सुनीथः सुमृडीकः स्ववाँ यात्वर्वाङ्। अपसेधन् रक्षसो यातुधानानस्थाद्देवः प्रतिदोषं गृणानः॥
verses.tr: hiraṇyahasto asuraḥ sunīthaḥ sumṛḍīkaḥ svavāṃ yātvarvāṅ apasedhan rakṣaso yātudhānānasthāddevaḥ pratidoṣaṃ gṛṇānaḥ

verses.sa: ये ते पन्थाः सवितः पूर्व्यासोऽरेणवः सुकृता अन्तरिक्षे। तेभिर्नो अद्य पथिभिः सुगेभी रक्षा च नो अधि च ब्रूहि देव॥
verses.tr: ye te panthāḥ savitaḥ pūrvyāso'reṇavaḥ sukṛtā antarikṣe tebhirno adya pathibhiḥ sugebhī rakṣā ca no adhi ca brūhi deva

verses.sa: उभा पिबतमश्विनोभा नः शर्म यच्छतम्। अविद्रियाभिरूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: ubhā pibatamaśvinobhā naḥ śarma yacchatam avidriyābhirūtibhiḥ

verses.sa: अप्नस्वतीमश्विना वाचमस्मे कृतं नो दस्रा वृषणा मनीषाम्। अद्यूत्येऽवसे नि ह्वये वां वृधे च नो भवतं वाजसातौ॥
verses.tr: apnasvatīmaśvinā vācamasme kṛtaṃ no dasrā vṛṣaṇā manīṣām adyūtye'vase ni hvaye vāṃ vṛdhe ca no bhavataṃ vājasātau
verses.en: Make ye our speech effectual, O Asvins, and this our hymn, ye mighty Wonder-workers. In luckless game I call on you for succour: strengthen us also on the field of battle.

verses.sa: द्युभिरक्तुभिः परि पातमस्मानरिष्टेभिरश्विना सौभगेभिः। तन्नो मित्रो वरुणो मामहन्तामदितिः सिन्धुः पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: dyubhiraktubhiḥ pari pātamasmānariṣṭebhiraśvinā saubhagebhiḥ tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ

verses.sa: आ कृष्णेन रजसा वर्तमानो निवेशयन्नमृतं मर्त्यं च। हिरण्ययेन सविता रथेना देवो याति भुवनानि पश्यन्॥
verses.tr: ā kṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca hiraṇyayena savitā rathenā devo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan

verses.sa: आ रात्रि पार्थिवं रजः पितुरप्रायि धामभिः। दिवः सदांसि बृहती वि तिष्ठस आ त्वेषं वर्तते तमः॥
verses.tr: ā rātri pārthivaṃ rajaḥ pituraprāyi dhāmabhiḥ divaḥ sadāṃsi bṛhatī vi tiṣṭhasa ā tveṣaṃ vartate tamaḥ

verses.sa: उषस्तच्चित्रमा भरास्मभ्यं वाजिनीवति। येन तोकं च तनयं च धामहे॥
verses.tr: uṣastaccitramā bharāsmabhyaṃ vājinīvati yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe
verses.en: O Dawn enriched with ample wealth, bestow on us that wondrous gift Wherewith we may support children and children's sons.

verses.sa: प्रातरग्निं प्रातरिन्द्रं हवामहे प्रातर्मित्रावरुणा प्रातरश्विना। प्रातर्भगं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं प्रातः सोममुत रुद्रं हुवेम॥
verses.tr: prātaragniṃ prātarindraṃ havāmahe prātarmitrāvaruṇā prātaraśvinā prātarbhagaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ prātaḥ somamuta rudraṃ huvema
verses.en: Agni at dawn, and Indra we invoke at dawn, and Varims and Mitra and the Asvins twain, Bhaga at dawn, PAshan and Brahmanaspati, Soma at dawn, Rudra may we invoke at dawn.

verses.sa: प्रातर्जितं भगमुग्रं हुवेम वयं पुत्रमदितेर्यो विधर्ता। आध्रश्चिद्यं मन्यमानस्तुरश्चिद्राजा चिद्यं भगं भक्षीत्याह॥
verses.tr: prātarjitaṃ bhagamugraṃ huvema vayaṃ putramaditeryo vidhartā ādhraścidyaṃ manyamānasturaścidrājā cidyaṃ bhagaṃ bhakṣītyāha
verses.en: May we invoke strong early-conquering Bhaga, the Son of Aditi, the great Arranger, Thinking of whom the poor, yea, even the mighty, even the King says. Let me share in Bhaga.

verses.sa: भग प्रणेतर्भग सत्यराधो भगेमां धियमुदवा ददन्नः। भग प्र नो जनय गोभिरश्वैर्भग प्र नृभिर्नृवन्तः स्याम॥
verses.tr: bhaga praṇetarbhaga satyarādho bhagemāṃ dhiyamudavā dadannaḥ bhaga pra no janaya gobhiraśvairbhaga pra nṛbhirnṛvantaḥ syāma
verses.en: Bhaga our guide, Bhaga whose gifts are faithful, &favour this prayer and give us wealth, O Bhaga. Bhaga, increase our store of kine and horses: Bhaga, may we be rich in men and heroes.

verses.sa: उतेदानीं भगवन्तः स्यामोत प्रपित्व उत मध्ये अह्नाम्। उतोदिता मघवन्त्सूर्यस्य वयं देवानां सुमतौ स्याम॥
verses.tr: utedānīṃ bhagavantaḥ syāmota prapitva uta madhye ahnām utoditā maghavantsūryasya vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma
verses.en: So may felicity be ours at present, and when the day approaches, and at noontide; And may we still, O Bounteous One, at sunset be happy is the Deities loving-kindness.

verses.sa: भग एव भगवाँ२ अस्तु देवास्तेन वयं भगवन्तः स्याम। तं त्वा भग सर्व इज्जोहवीति स नो भग पुर एता भवेह॥
verses.tr: bhaga eva bhagavāṃ2 astu devāstena vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma taṃ tvā bhaga sarva ijjohavīti sa no bhaga pura etā bhaveha
verses.en: May Bhaga verily be Bliss-bestower, and through him, Gods! I may happiness attend us. As such, O Bhaga, all with might invoke thee: as such be thou our Champion here, O Bhaga.

verses.sa: समध्वरायोषसो नमन्त दधिक्रावेव शुचये पदाय। अर्वाचीनं वसुविदं भगं नो रथमिवाश्वा वाजिन आ वहन्तु॥
verses.tr: samadhvarāyoṣaso namanta dadhikrāveva śucaye padāya arvācīnaṃ vasuvidaṃ bhagaṃ no rathamivāśvā vājina ā vahantu
verses.en: To 'this our worship may the Dawns incline them, and come to the pure place like Dadhikravan. As strong steeds draw a chariot may they b bring us hitherward Bhaga who discovers treasure.

verses.sa: अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्न उषासो वीरवतीः सदमुच्छन्तु भद्राः। घृतं दुहाना विश्वतः प्रपीता यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: aśvāvatīrgomatīrna uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadamucchantu bhadrāḥ ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: May friendly Mornings dawn on us for ever, with wealth of kine, of horses, and of heroes, Streaming with.all abundance, pouring fatness. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa: पूषन् तव व्रते वयं न रिष्येम कदा चन। स्तोतारस्त इह स्मसि॥
verses.tr: pūṣan tava vrate vayaṃ na riṣyema kadā cana stotārasta iha smasi
verses.en: Secure in thy m tby protecting care, O PAshan, never may we fall: We here are singers of thy praise.

verses.sa: पथस्पथः परिपतिं वचस्या कामेन कृतो अभ्यानडर्कम्। स नो रासच्छुरुधश्चन्द्राग्रा धियं-धियं सीषधाति प्र पूषा॥
verses.tr: pathaspathaḥ paripatiṃ vacasyā kāmena kṛto abhyānaḍarkam sa no rāsacchurudhaścandrāgrā dhiyaṃ-dhiyaṃ sīṣadhāti pra pūṣā
verses.en: I praise with eloquence him who guards w all pathways. He, when his love impelled him, went to Arka. May be he vouchsafe us u^i gear with gold to 'grace it: may make each prayer of ours effective.

verses.sa: त्रीणि पदा वि चक्रमे विष्णुर्गोपा अदाभ्यः। अतो धर्माणि धारयन्॥
verses.tr: trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇurgopā adābhyaḥ ato dharmāṇi dhārayan
verses.en: Vishnu the undeceivable Protector' strode three steps, thence forth Establishing his high decrees.

verses.sa: तद्विप्रासो विपन्यवो जागृवांसः समिन्धते। विष्णोर्यत्परमं पदम्॥
verses.tr: tadviprāso vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam
verses.en: This, Vishnu's station most sublime, the singers ever vigilant, Lovers of holy song, light up.

verses.sa: घृतवती भुवनानामभिश्रियोर्वी पृथ्वी मधुदुघे सुपेशसा। द्यावापृथिवी वरुणस्य धर्मणा विष्कभिते अजरे भूरिरेतसा॥
verses.tr: ghṛtavatī bhuvanānāmabhiśriyorvī pṛthvī madhudughe supeśasā dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇasya dharmaṇā viṣkabhite ajare bhūriretasā
verses.en: Filled full of fatness, compassing all things that be, wide, spacious, dropping meath, beautiful in their form, The Heaven and the Earth by Vanina's decree, unwasting, rich in seed, stand parted each from each.

verses.sa: ये नः सपत्ना अप ते भवन्त्विन्द्राग्निभ्यामव बाधामहे तान्। वसवो रुद्रा आदित्या उपरिस्पृशं मोग्रं चेत्तारमधिराजमक्रन्॥
verses.tr: ye naḥ sapatnā apa te bhavantvindrāgnibhyāmava bādhāmahe tān vasavo rudrā ādityā uparispṛśaṃ mograṃ cettāramadhirājamakran
verses.en: Let those who are our foemen stand afar from us: with India and with Agni we will drive them off. Vasus, Adityas, Rudras have exalted me, made me preeminent, mighty, thinker, sovran lord.

verses.sa: आ नासत्या त्रिभिरेकादशैरिह देवेभिर्यातं मधुपेयमश्विना। प्रायुस्तारिष्टं नी रपांसि मृक्षतं सेधतं द्वेषो भवतं सचाभुवा॥
verses.tr: ā nāsatyā tribhirekādaśairiha devebhiryātaṃ madhupeyamaśvinā prāyustāriṣṭaṃ nī rapāṃsi mṛkṣataṃ sedhataṃ dveṣo bhavataṃ sacābhuvā
verses.en: Come, O NAsatyas, with the thrice eleven Gods; come, O ye Asvins, to the drinking of the meath. Prolong our days of life, and wipe out all our sins: ward off our enemies; be with us evermore.

verses.sa: एष व स्तोमो मरुत इयं गीर्मान्दार्यस्य मान्यस्य कारोः। एषा यासीष्ट तन्वे वयां विद्यामेषं वृजनं जीरदानुम्॥
verses.tr: eṣa va stomo maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ eṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum
verses.en: May this your praise, may this your song, O Maruts, sung Bring offspring for ourselves with food to feed a. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sa: सहस्तोमाः सहच्छन्दस आवृतः सहप्रमा ऋषयः सप्त दैव्याः। पूर्वेषां पन्थामनुदृश्य धीरा अन्वालेभिरे रथ्यो न रश्मीन्॥
verses.tr: sahastomāḥ sahacchandasa āvṛtaḥ sahapramā ṛṣayaḥ sapta daivyāḥ pūrveṣāṃ panthāmanudṛśya dhīrā anvālebhire rathyo na raśmīn
verses.en: They who were versed in ritual and metre, in hymns and rules, were the Seven godlike Bishis. Viewing the path of those of old, the sages have taken up the reins like chariot-drivers.

verses.sa: आयुष्यं वर्चस्यं रायस्पोषमौद्भिदम्। इदं हिरण्यं वर्चस्वज्जैत्रायाविशतादु माम्॥
verses.tr: āyuṣyaṃ varcasyaṃ rāyaspoṣamaudbhidam idaṃ hiraṇyaṃ varcasvajjaitrāyāviśatādu mām
verses.en: Bestowing splendour, length of life, increase of wealth, and conquering power, This brightly shining gold shall be attached to me for victory.

verses.sa: न तद्रक्षांसि न पिशाचास्तरन्ति देवानामोजः प्रथमजं ह्येतत्। यो बिभर्ति दाक्षायणं हिरण्यं स देवेषु कृणुते दीर्घमायुः स मनुष्येषु कृणुते दीर्घमायुः॥
verses.tr: na tadrakṣāṃsi na piśācāstaranti devānāmojaḥ prathamajaṃ hyetat yo bibharti dākṣāyaṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ sa deveṣu kṛṇute dīrghamāyuḥ sa manuṣyeṣu kṛṇute dīrghamāyuḥ
verses.en: This gold DO demons injure, no Pisachas; for this is might of Gods, their primal offspring. Whoever wears the gold of Daksha's children lives a long. life among the Gods, lives a long life among mankind.

verses.sa: यदाबध्नन् दाक्षायणा हिरण्यं शतानीकाय सुमनस्यमानाः। तन्म आ बध्नामि शतशारदायायुष्माञ्जरदष्टिर्यथासम्॥
verses.tr: yadābadhnan dākṣāyaṇā hiraṇyaṃ śatānīkāya sumanasyamānāḥ tanma ā badhnāmi śataśāradāyāyuṣmāñjaradaṣṭiryathāsam
verses.en: This ornament of gold which Daksha's children bound, with benevolent thoughts, on §Satanika, I bind on me for life through hundred autumns, that I may live till ripe old age o'ertakes me.

verses.sa: उत नोऽहिर्बुध्न्यः शृणोत्वज एकपात्पृथिवी समुद्रः। विश्वे देवा ऋतावृधो हुवाना स्तुता मन्त्राः कविशस्ता अवन्तु॥
verses.tr: uta no'hirbudhnyaḥ śṛṇotvaja ekapātpṛthivī samudraḥ viśve devā ṛtāvṛdho huvānā stutā mantrāḥ kaviśastā avantu
verses.en: Let Ahibudhnya also hear our calling, and Aja-Ekapad and Earth and Ocean. All Gods Law-strengtheners, invoked and lauded, and Texts recited by the sages, help us!

verses.sa: इमा गिर आदित्येभ्यो घृतस्नूः सनाद्राजभ्यो जुह्वा जुहोमि। शृणोतु मित्रो अर्यमा भगो नस्तुविजातो वरुणो दक्षो अंशः॥
verses.tr: imā gira ādityebhyo ghṛtasnūḥ sanādrājabhyo juhvā juhomi śṛṇotu mitro aryamā bhago nastuvijāto varuṇo dakṣo aṃśaḥ
verses.en: These hymns that drop down fatness, with the ladle I ever offer to the Kings Adityas. May Mitra, Aryaman, and Bhaga hear us, the mighty Varuna, Daksha, and Am a.

verses.sa: सप्त ऋषयः प्रतिहिताः शरीरे सप्त रक्षन्ति सदमप्रमादम्। सप्तापः स्वपतो लोकमीयुस्तत्र जागृतो अस्वप्नजौ सत्रसदौ च देवौ॥
verses.tr: sapta ṛṣayaḥ pratihitāḥ śarīre sapta rakṣanti sadamapramādam saptāpaḥ svapato lokamīyustatra jāgṛto asvapnajau satrasadau ca devau
verses.en: Seven Bishis are established in the body: seven guard it evermore with care unceasing. Seven waters seek the world of him who lies asleep: two sleepless Gods are feast-fellows of him who wakes.

verses.sa: उत्तिष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते देवयन्तस्त्वेमहे। उप प्र यन्तु मरुतः सुदानव इन्द्र प्राशूर्भवा सचा॥
verses.tr: uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate devayantastvemahe upa pra yantu marutaḥ sudānava indra prāśūrbhavā sacā
verses.en: O Brahmanaspati, arise. God-fearing men, we pray to thee. May they who give good gifts, the Maruts, come to us. Indra,. be thou most swift with them.

verses.sa: प्र नूनं ब्रह्मणस्पतिर्मन्त्रं वदत्युक्थ्यम्। यस्मिन्निन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा देवा ओकांसि चक्रिरे॥
verses.tr: pra nūnaṃ brahmaṇaspatirmantraṃ vadatyukthyam yasminnindro varuṇo mitro aryamā devā okāṃsi cakrire
verses.en: Now Brahmanaspati speaks forth aloud the solemn hymn of praise, Wherein Indra and Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, the Gods' have made their dwelling-place.

verses.sa: ब्रह्मणस्पते त्वमस्य यन्ता सूक्तस्य बोधि तनयं च जिन्व। विश्वं तद्भद्रं यदवन्ति देवा बृहद्वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥ य इमा विश्वा विश्वकर्मा यो नः पिता ऽन्नपतेऽन्नस्य नो देहि॥
verses.tr: brahmaṇaspate tvamasya yantā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva viśvaṃ tadbhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ya imā viśvā viśvakarmā yo naḥ pitā 'nnapate'nnasya no dehi
verses.en: Brahmanaspati, be thou controller of this our hymn, and aud prosper thou our children. All that the 'Gods regard with love is blessed. Loud may we speak, with brave sons, in assembly. He who sate 'down. Mighty in mind. Father who made us. A share of good, O Lord of Food.
